rationale: Optimized thermal dispatch using linear programming to minimize cost while meeting residual load and emission constraints. Coal is cheaper ($22/MWh) but has higher emissions (0.75 ton/MWh), while gas is more expensive ($38/MWh) but cleaner (0.35 ton/MWh). The solution uses minimum gas (20 MW) in all hours to meet the residual loads (75, 90, 85 MW) while staying under the 200 ton emission cap.
